NIL dated 15.10.2020 seeking registration in accordance with Department of Expenditure Order No. F. 6/18/2019-PPD dated 23.07.2020 and to convey that competent authority has approved grant of registration on the following terms and conditions to the entity mentioned below: Name of the applicant entity M/s Apraava Energy Pvt. Ltd Registered Office 5 th Floor, Chanakya Building, Off Ashram Road, Ahmedabad-380009 Corporate Office 7 th Floor, Fulcrum , Sahar Road, Andheri (East), Mumbai- 400 099 ltem/s for which registration is granted 1. Power (Electricity generation); 11. Transmission services for transmitting electricity; ... Distribution services for supply of 11 1. electricity (including as a distribution licensee and franchisee) ~alidity of registration 03 years from the date of issue of this certificate, i.e ., 19th December 2024 2. The Registration is only for the purpose of participation in public procurement in India in accordance with DoE Order (Public Procurement No.1) dated 23.07.2020 for supply of items (goods/ works I services) from the premises mentioned above. 3. In case of appointment of new Director(s)/shareholders with more than 10% shares /change in controlling ownership interest or control through other means, this Registration shall automatically stand annulled .
